description: Congestion management activations - Countertrading (Local) - data as of 22/05/2024 is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Local activations performed by Elia inside its control area in the framework of countertrading activations for congestion management ﻿This dataset contains data from 22/05/2024 (ICAROS local go-live) on. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Congestion management. Its keywords are Activations, EU Reg. No 534/2013. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
